title: Step 3: SVM Regression: Creating & Training SVR Model with RBF Kernel in Python

cues.en: Narrator: Hello my friends!
cues.zh: 朋友們好！

cues.en: Welcome to this new tutorial.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這堂新教學。

cues.en: And now we're about to train the SVR model on the whole dataset after a successful data pre-processing phase with your new experience in feature scaling,
cues.zh: 成功完成資料前處理，也透過特徵縮放累積新經驗後，現在要在整份資料集上訓練 SVR 模型，

cues.en: because now you can handle very well all the different situations.
cues.zh: 因為你已經能熟練處理這裡各種不同情境。

cues.en: Alright, so let's train that SVR model on the whole dataset of course because we did not do a split of the dataset between training and test sets.
cues.zh: 來訓練 SVR 模型，當然是使用整份資料集，因為沒有切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new code cell and now let's build, of course in the most efficient way, the SVR model.
cues.zh: 新增程式碼儲存格，現在當然以最有效率的方式，建立 SVR 模型。

cues.en: So we're gonna build it with SciKit-Learn of course.
cues.zh: 當然會使用 scikit-learn。

cues.en: I remind that SciKit-Learn is the best data science library, excluding deep learning because of course we have TensorFlow and PyTorch.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，我認為 scikit-learn 是最好的資料科學程式庫；深度學習除外，因為還有 TensorFlow 和 PyTorch。

cues.en: But for any machine learning model that is not based on neural networks, well, SciKit-Learn is definitely by far the best data science library.
cues.zh: 但對於不以神經網路為基礎的機器學習模型，我認為 scikit-learn 絕對是最好的資料科學程式庫。

cues.en: And for what we are interested in right now you know the SVR model.
cues.zh: 至於現在感興趣的 SVR 模型，

cues.en: Well, we will build it with a class called SVR as we are as simple as that, which belongs to a module of SciKit-Learn called SVM.
cues.zh: 會用一個叫做 SVR 的類別來建立，名字就是這麼簡單。它屬於 scikit-learn 的 svm 模組。

cues.en: And so we have to start here from first, SciKit-Learn to access the SciKit-Learn library from which we're gonna get access to that SVM modules.
cues.zh: 所以先寫 from sklearn，存取 scikit-learn 程式庫，再取得其中的 svm 模組。

cues.en: That's the module from which we're going to import that SVR class.
cues.zh: 我們會從這個模組，匯入 SVR 類別。

cues.en: Perfect. Now we have the class, and you of course know the next natural step anytime you import a class.
cues.zh: 很好，現在有類別了。你當然知道，每次匯入類別後，自然的下一步是什麼。

cues.en: The next natural step is of course to create an object or an instance of this class.
cues.zh: 下一步當然是建立這個類別的物件，也就是實例。

cues.en: And we're gonna call that object regressor just like before, because this instance or object of the SVR class is nothing else than
cues.zh: 和先前一樣，把物件命名為 regressor，因為 SVR 類別的實例或物件，其實就是

cues.en: the SVR regressor itself.
cues.zh: SVR 迴歸器本身。

cues.en: You know, the support vector for regression regressor.
cues.zh: 也就是支援向量迴歸的迴歸器。

cues.en: So regressor and then of course we are going to call this class SVR add some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 輸入 regressor，接著當然呼叫 SVR 類別，加上括號。

cues.en: And this time we have to input a parameter because indeed remember in the intuition lecture of support vector regression.
cues.zh: 這次需要輸入一個參數，因為記得在支援向量迴歸的直覺課程中，

cues.en: And you will also see in the intuition lecture of the support vector machine in the next part part three classification.
cues.zh: 以及之後第三部分「分類」裡，支援向量機的直覺課程中，

cues.en: Well, you actually have what we call kernels, which can either learn some linear relationships and that's the linear kernel or non-linear relationships
cues.zh: 會談到所謂的核函數。它可以學習資料集中的線性關係，那就是線性核，或是非線性關係，

cues.en: in your dataset, which are the non-linear kernels, such as the RBF radial basis.
cues.zh: 那就是非線性核，例如 RBF，也就是徑向基底函數。

cues.en: I will actually show it to you right away.
cues.zh: 我現在直接展示給你看。

cues.en: You know, that's the Gaussian RBF Kernel, which is given by this formula.
cues.zh: 這就是高斯 RBF 核，以這個公式表示。

cues.en: And I can actually show you the plot of that kernel.
cues.zh: 也可以展示這個核函數的圖形。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So that's the Gaussian RBF Kernel.
cues.zh: 這就是高斯 RBF 核。

cues.en: And then you also have some other kernels, which I've prepared here on this great website showing clearly the different kernels of the support vector machine, but also the SVR because SVR is nothing else
cues.zh: 此外還有其他核函數。我準備了這個很棒的網站，清楚展示支援向量機的不同核函數，SVR 也適用，因為 SVR 其實就是

cues.en: than a support vector machine model for regression.
cues.zh: 用於迴歸的支援向量機模型。

cues.en: So let's see, here they are.
cues.zh: 來看看，就在這裡。

cues.en: There is the Polynomial Kernel, adapted for non-linear dataset.
cues.zh: 有適用於非線性資料集的多項式核。

cues.en: You have the Gaussian Kernel, which has a classic Gaussian function then the Gaussian Radial Basis function, the most widely used one and that's actually the one we will use.
cues.zh: 有使用典型高斯函數的高斯核，以及高斯徑向基底函數；這是最廣泛使用的一種，也是我們要用的。

cues.en: Then you have the Laplace one, the Hyperbolic Tangent Kernel as well.
cues.zh: 接著有拉普拉斯核，也有雙曲正切核。

cues.en: That's a popular one.
cues.zh: 這也是很常見的一種。

cues.en: Sigmoid in well, you have all of them here.
cues.zh: 還有 Sigmoid，這裡都有列出。

cues.en: And so if you're curious, yes, you can have a look at them.
cues.zh: 如果好奇，可以看看。

cues.en: But, the one we will use for our implementation will be and that's the one I recommend each time you experiment with an SVR model and that's the radial basis function kernel,
cues.zh: 不過這次實作要使用的，也是我建議每次試驗 SVR 模型時可以先用的，就是徑向基底函數核，

cues.en: the RBF kernel.
cues.zh: 也就是 RBF 核。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we have to input here in our parameters.
cues.zh: 這正是參數裡要輸入的內容。

cues.en: And so the name of that parameter is kernel.
cues.zh: 參數的名稱是 kernel。

cues.en: So that's the name of the parameter.
cues.zh: 這就是參數名稱。

cues.en: And then the value we want for that parameter, which you know corresponds to the radial basis function has the code name in quotes, RBF and that's it.
cues.zh: 這個參數的值，要對應徑向基底函數，在程式中是引號裡的 rbf，就這樣。

cues.en: That's only what we have to input here.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要輸入這個參數。

cues.en: So that basically creates the SVR model with the Radial Basis Function Kernel.
cues.zh: 基本上，這就建立了使用徑向基底函數核的 SVR 模型。

cues.en: And so now that means only one thing.
cues.zh: 現在這代表一件事。

cues.en: That means that we already have built the model, we already have the SVR model itself.
cues.zh: 代表已經建立好模型，已經有 SVR 模型本身了。

cues.en: And so now the last final natural step is to of course train that regressor on the whole dataset, right?
cues.zh: 接下來最後一個自然的步驟，當然是在整份資料集上訓練迴歸器，對吧？

cues.en: Which is also the training set.
cues.zh: 而整份資料集也就是訓練集。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，來做吧。

cues.en: You know exactly how to do this, you know, from this point it's exactly the same as before.
cues.zh: 你已經完全知道怎麼做，從這裡開始，和之前完全一樣。

cues.en: You know the same function, which is of course the fit function and which will train this SVR model on your whole dataset, right?
cues.zh: 使用同一個函式，當然就是 fit，讓 SVR 模型在整份資料集上訓練。

cues.en: To learn the correlations between the position levels and the salaries and all this done with the Radial Basis Function Kernel.
cues.zh: 藉此學習職位等級與薪資之間的關係，而這些都是透過徑向基底函數核完成。

cues.en: Alright, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，來做吧。

cues.en: Let's train our regressor.
cues.zh: 訓練我們的迴歸器。

cues.en: So we take our regressor object first, and as usual we add here a dot.
cues.zh: 先使用 regressor 物件，和往常一樣，在這裡加上一個點。

cues.en: And then the fit method, which takes as input this time not X train and Y train because we have not created a separate training set.
cues.zh: 接著是 fit 方法。這次的輸入不是 X_train 與 y_train，因為沒有另外建立訓練集。

cues.en: But of course this time the whole dataset, which remember was feature scaled, you know both on the matrix features export and the dependent variable Y part.
cues.zh: 而是整份資料集。記得，特徵矩陣 X 與依變數 y，這兩個部分都已經做過特徵縮放。

cues.en: And so that's exactly what we have to input here both X and Y.
cues.zh: 所以這裡正是要傳入 X 和 y。

cues.en: And that's it. Congratulations!
cues.zh: 完成了，恭喜！

cues.en: Now you know, how to build and train an SVR model after a successful data pre-processing phase, including a special feature scaling.
cues.zh: 現在你知道，成功完成包含特殊特徵縮放的資料前處理後，如何建立並訓練 SVR 模型。

cues.en: Alright, and so now we have a very interesting next step.
cues.zh: 好，接下來有一個很有意思的步驟。

cues.en: It is the step where we predict the new result.
cues.zh: 就是預測新結果。

cues.en: And this next step is very interesting because it will teach you how to reverse the scaling of your prediction because you will see that when we apply the predict method to predict
cues.zh: 這一步很有意思，因為會教你如何將預測的縮放反轉。你會看到，使用 predict 方法預測

cues.en: this new result, well it will be returned in the scale that was used for why, right?
cues.zh: 新結果時，回傳的是 y 所使用尺度下的數值，對吧？

cues.en: The new scale of why after it was transformed.
cues.zh: 也就是 y 轉換後的新尺度。

cues.en: And so we'll have to reverse this transformation.
cues.zh: 所以需要反轉這個轉換。

cues.en: We'll have to reverse the scaling in order to get the original scale of why, and I will teach you exactly how to do it in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 必須將縮放反轉，才能取得 y 原本尺度的數值。下一堂課會確切教你如何操作。
